title: Find Company Contact Emails in Bulk With LinkFinder AI
coverSub: From a list of company names to their contact emails
cover: In this video we are going to see how to find the contact email of every company on a list using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. 9 company names went in, and every one came back with its contact email, ready to export. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: a list of companies in, contact emails out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the phone number of every company on a list.
outroHeadline: Get a contact email for every company
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results from the LinkFinder AI API, 12 Nov 2026

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Pick A company's contact email, from its name. It costs five credits per company.

click.text: A company's contact email, from its name

steps.narration: Fill in the company name. We type Shopify.
In a couple of seconds you get info at shopify dot com, a real inbox at the company, not a guess.
Now do it for a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV. One column of company names is enough. Ours has 9, from HubSpot to Atlassian.
You see the rows before anything runs, so you know exactly what you will spend.
The contact emails come in row by row while you watch.
9 companies in, 9 contact emails out, every one marked Found. Five credits each.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV, ready for your CRM or your next enrichment.
